target_customer: Consumers seeking mental health support (subscription), plus employers, providers and payers via enterprise deals
problem: Therapy is expensive and hard to access. Sonia offers voice and text AI coaching built on cognitive behavioral techniques, later with licensed therapist video sessions.
business_model: Consumer subscription ($20 per month or $200 per year at 2024 launch per TechCrunch) plus enterprise partnerships

founders.name: Dustin Klebe
founders.background_notes: AI research at MIT; president of the German Excellence Scholarship KAS (YC page).

founders.name: Lukas Wolf
education: ETH Zurich and MIT, computer science, AI and NLP research
founders.background_notes: Research labs at ETH and MIT (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice based LLM conversations with safety constraints for mental health need careful prompt, evaluation and guardrail work, but rely on third party models.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical oversight and safety research help, but LLM coaching apps were easy for others and for general chatbots to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General chatbots became substitutes; Woebot shut its consumer chatbot in June 2025 per one report. No sourced move against Sonia.

market_need_then: Therapist access and cost problems are well documented; Sonia reported about 8,000 users at its June 2024 launch coverage and cited demand from mental health organizations.

branding.name_origin: Company site says the name has a Greek root meaning wisdom and uses a star symbol drawn from a wisdom knot
branding.domain_note: Uses soniahealth.com, a descriptive suffix rather than sonia.com; another unrelated European company also called Sonia exists.

identity.logo: Star shaped symbol from the wisdom knot
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, open and nonjudgmental: What's on your mind?

branding.brand_signature: Star guide symbol and the invitation What's on your mind?
branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage by TechCrunch and syndicated outlets in June 2024; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly human name and consistent warm voice, press coverage at launch, but a generic first name shared with unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Sonia raised a roughly $3.35M seed in June 2024 after YC W24 and launched a paid voice AI therapy app with about 8,000 users. It later added couples coaching and licensed therapist sessions in California plus enterprise offers. The generative AI wave was a tailwind, while general chatbots and AI therapy criticism are risks. No later round, exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Seed of $3.35M confirmed by TechCrunch and NewsBytes; trackers round it to $3.4M. Press also names Chris Aeberli as a third co-founder, but the YC page lists only Klebe and Wolf, so he is not recorded. A claim of $2M 2024 revenue on an aggregator is unverified. Competitors left empty: only 2025 and 2026 overview pages were found for Woebot, Wysa and Replika, not dated near the batch.
